answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Each submission hangs on the ember of a task receipt, and the glacier is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a developer-centric, implementation details matter register, it stays short. What survives to the crystal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on layered finality with probabilistic guarantees.
